target.title: fix(msteams): add timeouts to file consent upload requests
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Teams file consent uploads validated the SharePoint consent URL, then performed the upload PUT without a request deadline. If the upload request never completed, the accepted file delivery path could remain pending indefinitely.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add a bounded consent upload timeout using the existing timer timeout resolver, and keep the abort timer active until the upload request finishes. The upload deadline is transfer-aware: it keeps a 5 minute base stall bound, then adds size-derived transfer budget so valid large SharePoint uploads are not cut off by a fixed 5 minute ceiling. The SSRF host/IP validation and upload headers/body semantics are unchanged.

## User Impact

When a Teams file consent upload stalls, OpenClaw now aborts the request instead of waiting forever, so the file delivery flow can fail quickly and surface the error path. Large valid file-consent uploads get additional budget based on payload size instead of sharing the same fixed deadline as a small upload.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/msteams/src/file-consent.test.ts extensions/msteams/src/request-timeout.test.ts` passed: 68 tests.
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check extensions/msteams/src/request-timeout.ts extensions/msteams/src/file-consent.ts extensions/msteams/src/file-consent.test.ts extensions/msteams/src/request-timeout.test.ts` passed.
- `node_modules/.bin/oxlint --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/msteams/src/request-timeout.ts extensions/msteams/src/file-consent.ts extensions/msteams/src/file-consent.test.ts extensions/msteams/src/request-timeout.test.ts` passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Transfer-aware proof: `resolveMSTeamsSharePointUploadTimeoutMs(100 * 1024 * 1024)` now resolves to 700000ms: 300000ms base plus 400000ms transfer budget at 256KiB/s.
- Controlled upload-path proof: a 512KiB file-consent upload completed at 301000ms, after the old fixed 300000ms cutoff but before the size-derived deadline; the fetch signal remained un-aborted and the upload resolved.
- Exact-head local HTTPS transport proof at `3702e4702fe54c8662f3536cf299399cfe2d5ade`: `uploadToConsentUrl` performed real HTTPS `PUT` requests against a loopback stalled/slow-success server. The harness used a self-signed certificate with `NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0` and a test validation override for the `127.0.0.1` allowlist/DNS so the local server could stand in for a Teams/SharePoint upload URL; the production upload path still validated HTTPS and sent the real request body, headers, and abort signal.

Command:

```text
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -subj "/CN=127.0.0.1" -keyout "$tmp/key.pem" -out "$tmp/cert.pem" -days 1
NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 node_modules/.bin/tsx --eval '<local HTTPS server + uploadToConsentUrl stalled/slow-success harness>'
```

Redacted transcript:

```json
{
  "exactHead": "3702e4702fe54c8662f3536cf299399cfe2d5ade",
  "baseUrl": "https://127.0.0.1:<redacted>",
  "validation": "local HTTPS proof uses NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 for the self-signed loopback certificate plus a test validation override for 127.0.0.1 allowlist/DNS; uploadToConsentUrl still validates HTTPS and performs real PUT requests",
  "results": [
    {
      "name": "stalled-put",
      "outcome": "threw",
      "elapsedMs": 263,
      "errorName": "TimeoutError",
      "errorMessage": "MS Teams file consent upload timed out after 250ms"
    },
    {
      "name": "slow-success-put",
      "outcome": "completed",
      "elapsedMs": 87
    }
  ],
  "events": [
    {
      "route": "stalled-put",
      "phase": "request-start",
      "method": "PUT",
      "url": "/stall",
      "contentRange": "bytes 0-1023/1024",
      "contentType": "application/octet-stream"
    },
    {
      "route": "stalled-put",
      "phase": "data",
      "bytes": 1024
    },
    {
      "route": "stalled-put",
      "phase": "request-end",
      "bytes": 1024
    },
    {
      "route": "stalled-put",
      "phase": "response-stall",
      "response": "intentionally withheld response headers/body"
    },
    {
      "route": "slow-success",
      "phase": "response-end",
      "response": "200 ok after 75ms"
    }
  ]
}
```

- Not run: live Microsoft Teams tenant / real SharePoint upload.
